metadata.name: bidguard
metadata.description: BidGuard: deposit-backed live auctions with escrow and AI-vetted listings

instructions.name: cancel_unsold
docs: No valid bids: the operator (who saw every bid) closes it and the seller gets the bond back.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The winning buyer's token account; for unsold auctions any account owned by the seller is fine (nothing is paid to it).

instructions.name: confirm_delivery
docs: The buyer is happy: pay the seller now and return their bond.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The winning buyer's token account; for unsold auctions any account owned by the seller is fine (nothing is paid to it).

instructions.name: create_auction
docs: Goes live only when the operator co-signs, i.e. after the agent crew approved the listing.
The seller posts a bond that is slashed if they lose a dispute or never ship.

accounts.name: operator
docs: The orchestrator's key: proves the agent crew approved this listing.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Pre-fund bidding power. Like registering with a deposit at a live auction house.

instructions.name: mark_delivered
docs: Carrier-tracking oracle: the operator reports delivery, which starts the buyer's review window.

instructions.name: refund_unshipped
docs: The seller never shipped: anyone may refund the buyer once the ship window passed.
The seller's bond goes to the buyer as compensation.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The winning buyer's token account; for unsold auctions any account owned by the seller is fine (nothing is paid to it).

instructions.name: release_after_timeout
docs: The buyer stayed silent after delivery: anyone may release once the review window passed.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The winning buyer's token account; for unsold auctions any account owned by the seller is fine (nothing is paid to it).

instructions.name: request_withdraw
docs: Withdrawals are two-step: request now, execute after the cooldown. The auction server
subtracts pending withdrawals from bidding power, so a bid can never be backed by money
that is about to leave.

instructions.name: resolve_dispute
docs: Executes a dispute outcome. The Dispute Judge Agent recommends `buyer_bps`; only the arbiter
key can execute it. Funds can only go to the buyer, the seller or the fee treasury.
If the buyer receives half or more, the seller's bond is slashed to the buyer.

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The winning buyer's token account; for unsold auctions any account owned by the seller is fine (nothing is paid to it).

instructions.name: set_agent
docs: Lets a buyer's Concierge Agent bid for them with its own key, up to a hard cap that the
program enforces at settlement. The agent can never spend more than `cap` in total.

instructions.name: settle_auction
docs: Settles the winning bid. The previous instruction in the transaction must be an Ed25519
signature check of the bid message, signed by the bidder (or their capped agent key).
Funds move straight from the winner's Bid Vault into this auction's escrow.

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero and within your balance

errors.name: InvalidEndTime
errors.msg: End time must be in the future

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: The auction is not in the right state for this

errors.name: BidTooLow
errors.msg: Bid is below the starting price

errors.name: MissingSignatureCheck
errors.msg: Missing the Ed25519 signature check for the bid

errors.name: AgentCapExceeded
errors.msg: The Concierge Agent would exceed its spending cap

errors.name: InsufficientVault
errors.msg: Not enough available funds in the Bid Vault

errors.name: CooldownActive
errors.msg: Withdrawal cooldown has not passed yet

errors.name: WindowNotPassed
errors.msg: The waiting period hasn't passed yet

errors.name: NoteTooLong
errors.msg: Text is empty or too long

fields.name: listing_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the approved listing (title, description, photos), tying the auction to what the agents checked.

fields.name: agent
docs: Optional Concierge Agent key allowed to sign bids for this vault, up to `agent_cap`.

fields.name: operator
docs: Auction server / agent orchestrator: approves listings, settles winning bids, reports delivery.

fields.name: arbiter
docs: Executes dispute outcomes recommended by the Dispute Judge Agent (a multisig in production).

types.name: SellerProfile
docs: Portable on-chain seller reputation.
